name: The Ritz-Carlton, Boston Common
insider_take: Boston's most prestigious address sits directly on the historic Common, where revolutionary spirits once gathered and luxury now reigns supreme.
whats_special: This is the only luxury hotel positioned directly on America's oldest public park, Boston Common. The property occupies a prime corner location where you can watch the famous Swan Boats glide by in summer and ice skaters twirl in winter. The hotel's Sports Club/LA spans two floors and features an indoor pool with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Common - a rare urban oasis in downtown Boston.
pro_tip: Book a Common-view room on higher floors for unobstructed views of the Public Garden and State House golden dome. The northwest corner rooms offer the most dramatic sunset views over the park.
dont_miss: Step outside your door onto the Freedom Trail - literally. The red brick trail runs right past the hotel, leading you to 16 historic sites including the State House (2 blocks), Granary Burying Ground where Sam Adams rests, and Faneuil Hall. The Theater District is just steps away, and you can walk to Newbury Street shopping in under 10 minutes through the Public Garden.
pros: Prime Boston Common location with easy access to Theater District and downtown attractions
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and luxury amenities
Elegant rooms and suites with city or park views
Exclusive access to Marriott STARS Program benefits and upgrades
cons: Premium luxury pricing typical of downtown Boston hotels
Limited parking availability in busy downtown location
